# Porcupine runtime distribution

This generated bundle contains @picovoice/porcupine-web 4.0.1 and
@picovoice/web-voice-processor 4.0.10, plus their npm dependencies.
Rebuild with `npm run bundle:porcupine`; versions and integrity are recorded in
package-lock.json. The WebVoiceProcessor Apache 2.0 license is supplied here;
Porcupine package metadata declares Apache-2.0 for its SDK wrapper.

The bundled WASM engine and custom keyword resources remain subject to the
Picovoice terms and account/AccessKey licensing. Wrapper license metadata does
not grant unrestricted commercial use of the engine or trained models.
See https://picovoice.ai/docs/quick-start/porcupine-web/ and the Picovoice Console.
No AccessKey, custom keyword model or French parameter model is distributed here.
